title: Melissa's ball of light from John Mack's Abduction

tellings.quote: cut to the 20th century Melissa in her early 20s saw a ball of light come through the sliding doors of her apartment bounce around the room go down the hall and into the other room

plain: A woman called Melissa, in her early twenties, saw a ball of light come through the sliding doors of her apartment, bounce around the room, go down the hall and into another room. Michels brings it up from Abduction, a 1994 book by John Mack, a psychiatrist who studied people reporting encounters with alien beings. He tells it to show that such visits of strange lights carry on into modern times, in a conversation about UFOs and religion.
